name: doubledoof
description: 2D web fighting game based on your game plan: - Single player (vs simple bot) and local multiplayer. - Player 1 (blue) uses WASD, Player 2 (red) uses Arrow keys. - Double-tap jump key for stronger jump. - Tap attack key for bat swing (10 damage, 1.5 body-length range). - Hold attack key to charge and release a projectile (10 to 50 damage over 10 seconds). - 100 HP each, 10 rounds, per-round scoring. - Different platform layouts by round. - Profile panel with generated username, editable/saved profile, demo email code verification, and friend invites.
